_comment: Skills, per GDD §5.1 (owner direction 2026-08-28/31, reaffirmed 2026-09-03: 'treat them like categories'). A `line` is a CATEGORY, never a box — a unit's loadout draws from as many lines as it likes, and 'class' is the label a particular combination produces. v25-v28 keyed these on `role` instead, which is exactly the fixed-class archetype §5.1 rejects; this replaces that. `weapon` gates a skill on what is in hand: an entry with `weapon: 'ranged'` is INERT while holding a knife and says so rather than hiding, because §5.1 is explicit that a build going live when a weapon drops is the payoff. `damageMode` says whether `damage` is a bonus on the weapon ('weapon') or the whole number ('flat'). `accuracy` REPLACES the weapon's hit chance; `accuracyMod` shifts it — separate fields because conflating them once turned a 70% ability into a 5% one.

lines.name: Slasher
lines.flavour: aggression — the fight rewards going forward

lines.name: Shiv
lines.flavour: positioning — hit what is already busy

lines.name: Enforcer
lines.flavour: ranged control — take away what they can do

lines.name: Bruiser
lines.flavour: impact — the board is a weapon

lines.name: Anchor
lines.flavour: zone control — hold ground for the others

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.blurb: Weapon damage to EVERY adjacent rival. Being surrounded stops being a death sentence and starts being an opportunity.

abilities.name: Takedown
abilities.blurb: +3 damage and a hard shove on one adjacent rival. The full-move finisher.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.blurb: Only on a rival already engaged by another operator — and then it hits for +4. The whole point is that somebody else set it up.

abilities.name: Openings
abilities.blurb: A cheap swing that pays +2 against anything one of your own is already next to. Works at whatever range you are holding.

abilities.name: Snap Shot
abilities.blurb: Two shots at one rival, each less accurate. Volume against a target you cannot afford to leave standing.

abilities.name: Steady
abilities.blurb: One shot that cannot miss, for +1. Cover, evasion and the dice all stop mattering.

abilities.name: Overwatch
abilities.blurb: Hold your fire. The first rival to move inside your range during their turn takes a shot — the answer to a board where crossing open ground was free.

abilities.name: Cripple
abilities.blurb: One damage, and they move two tiles less next turn. Taking away the approach is worth more than taking off health.

abilities.name: Shove
abilities.blurb: One damage, three tiles, never misses. The cheapest way to move a body onto something that hurts.

abilities.name: Wallop
abilities.blurb: A shove that hurts whatever it collides with, for 3. Needs something in hand that knocks back.

abilities.name: Barricade
abilities.blurb: Drop low cover on an empty tile beside you. The only thing in this game that changes the board in your favour.

abilities.name: Planted
abilities.blurb: End your turn planted: every adjacent ally is harder to shoot until your next turn. The skill that makes standing together mean something.
